newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 26.

text.p: These are significant stories in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ivory Coast's 1996/97 cocoa marketing campaign to start in October but coffee marketing campaign to be delayed until early 1997 because of market uncertainty.

- Ivorian government announces plan to split up and sell off of state cotton giant Compagnie Ivoirienne pour le Developpement des Textiles (CIDT), in which French textile company CFDT has a 30 percent stake. Three factory in north east to be sold as one lot, three in the north west to be sold as one lot and the CIDT will retain the remainder. The state will hold a 34 percent stake in the residue of the company, CFDT 30 percent. The rest will be sold to producers (20 pct), to staff (3 pct) and Ivorian nationals through the Abidjan Bourse (13 pct).

- Nine companies compete for contract to identify and map the streets of Ivory Coast's main city Abidjan; closing date for submissions is October 7 and winning company will be chosen in mid-October, the head of the state department organising the exercise says.

- Government to organise before December 25 the parliamentary and municipal elections delayed in opposition stronghold in western Ivory Coast because of violence surrounding the 1995 presidential election.

- Ivorian banana and pineapple producers meeting in main city Abidjan express concern about falling world prices; some say the trend threatens the survival of the sector -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
